b) Reference: cherry tomatoes (3 cm) are visible. Across the plate's lower-left to upper-right diagonal the plate spans roughly 9-10 tomato lengths on the long edge, which gives about 27-30 cm. Olives (2.2 cm) are similar in scale to the tomatoes.
